description: The full public document for one dataset as Markdown: summary, facts, access instructions, and every table with its columns, types, descriptions and units. No account needed. Example: {"id": "kden-metar-hourly"} — the `id` is a slug from search, and a canonical dataset URL works too. Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata: {slug, publisher, published_at, table_count, topics}}. publisher is the account that published the dataset, not the source it was gathered from. Cite the dataset by `url`. For machine-readable table ids and schemas, call get_dataset and get_table_schema instead.
name: fetch
title: Fetch a dataset document
